name: Stones of Binding
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Four Stones of Binding are scattered throughout Arathi.  These stones keep me pinned beneath the earth.

To unlock them you must unlock the strongest: the Stone of Inner Binding.  And to do that, you must gather keys from the other three.

These stones are watched by guardians, but if you are clever, or lucky, you may find ways to banish them.
narrative.objectives:
Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding.

Bring them to the Stone of Inner Binding.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Myzrael speaks through the stone.>

You have done it! You opened the Stones of Binding! I can feel the shackles about me loosen, and freedom draws ever closer.

You are a noble Champion, adventurer. My rescuer!
narrative.requestItemsText: This is the Stone of Inner Binding. It is the strongest of the binding stones and must be unlocked for the others to open.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 37 to 50, 25,800 XP in all.

quests.name: The Princess Trapped
quests.objectiveText: Gather 12 Motes of Myzrael, then bring them to the Iridescent Shards in Drywhisker Gorge.

quests.name: Stones of Binding
quests.objectiveText: Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding. Bring them to the Stone

quests.name: Myzrael's Allies
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge.

quests.name: The Lost Fragments
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.

quests.name: Summoning the Princess
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her. Gather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
